## Observation

A LINK whose stored `target_id` is a short form (for example a 4-hex quad) that DOES resolve to exactly 1 ticket cannot be removed by `unlink`. `process_link` (`src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:200-214`) resolves the raw target at replay, so `show` lists the canonical id. `_get_link_info` (`src/rebar/_commands/unlink.py:42`) compares the stored raw string against the canonical id `unlink_core` resolved, so neither form matches.

Reproduced in a sandbox store on 2026-11-03: a `caused_by` LINK written with target `<quad>` (unique). `show` listed the full id. `rebar.unlink(bug, <quad>, "caused_by")` and `rebar.unlink(bug, <full id>, "caused_by")` both failed with "Error: no LINK event found ... targeting '<full id>' with relation 'caused_by'". The dep stayed.

`_is_active_link` (`src/rebar/graph/_links.py:84`) compares stored raw targets the same way.

## Impact

Links written with a non-canonical target before `rebar link` / close started refusing unresolved targets (surprising-fruticose-herring) cannot be removed through a supported command once their short target becomes unique, even though `show` displays them as ordinary links.

## Not yet checked

How many stored LINK events in the live store carry a non-canonical `target_id`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `rebar unlink <source> <target> [relation]` removes a net-active link whose stored `target_id` resolves to the same canonical id the input resolves to. A unit test writes a LINK with a unique 4-hex target and removes it by both the 4-hex and the full id.
- [x] A stored ambiguous 4-hex target is not removed by one of the full ids it could mean: `unlink` refuses and writes no UNLINK.
- [x] A stored short target that resolves to a different ticket is never removed when another ticket is named; with 2 short-target links on one source, only the named ticket's link is removed.
- [x] A link folded into a SNAPSHOT by compaction is removable both when its stored short target now resolves (by the short and full forms) and, through the exact-string path from Gerrit 3262, when it does not resolve.
- [x] `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0 with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- [x] [non-codebase] The fix change is merged to `main` through Gerrit with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`.
